label: FGFR2::INA

sections.text: FGFR2 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase.
INA encodes alpha-internexin, a neuronal intermediate filament protein.

The fusion preserves the FGFR2 kinase region while altering its carboxy-terminal regulatory architecture; partner-mediated self-association can sustain FGFR signaling. FGFR2::INA was detected in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
Futibatinib is US-approved for adults with previously treated, unresectable locally advanced or metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring an FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement.
